title: Arkret AvailabilityReceipt
description: Content-addressed signed holder commitment that exact Event bytes remain available until retention_expires_at. receipt_digest is the full canonical content digest of the nested receipt, including its signature; no Merkle-root surrogate replaces the receipt bytes.

receipt_digest.description: Realm-suite digest over RFC 8785 JCS of the complete nested receipt, including signature. It is never computed over this wrapper.

bytes_digest.description: Realm-suite digest of UTF8('ak.availability-event-bytes-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(the complete accepted EventEnvelope with only unsigned removed). event_id, actor_kind and all accepted producer/principal-server proofs remain in the preimage.

availability_receipt_content.description: The signature-free core is {realm_id,event_id,bytes_digest,holder_id,retention_expires_at,holder_signer_evidence_ref,holder_signer_evidence_digest}. bytes_digest binds the complete accepted Event bytes except unsigned and is not event_id; verifier separately recomputes event_digest/event_id and every accepted proof. signature.payload_digest is the Realm-suite digest of RFC 8785 JCS(core). signature signs RFC 8785 JCS({context:'ak.availability_receipt_proof.v1',payload_digest,...core,verification_method,created_at}). holder_signer_evidence_digest equals the digest encoded by holder_signer_evidence_ref. The resolved evidence authorizes signature.verification_method for holder_id at signing time; current DID state is not a historical-key substitute.
